name: Light Gratitude
description: Eight work-friendly prompts for noticing what is going well, with optional notes that stay on this device.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eight light, work-friendly gratitude prompts, shown on Reflection Prompts.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Notice what you notice.
howToPlay: Read the prompt and let a small answer come to mind.
If you like, type a few words in the notes box. They stay on this device.
Press Next for another prompt, or Back to return.
tips: It is fine to pass on a prompt. Clear your notes any time.
